items.headline: Our Apple Watch App Is Here

shortText.plaintext: Keep your boarding pass, flight updates, and trip information right on your wrist.

longText.html:
Your journey just got even more convenient. With our new Apple Watch app, key travel information is always just a glance away—right on your wrist.

New features include:

  • Mobile Boarding Pass - store your boarding pass on your Apple Watch and move through security and boarding with ease.
  • My Flights - view important details for all your upcoming trips, including real-time flight status updates.
  • Trip Assistant Lite - receive timely, flight-phase–specific information throughout your journey.

Designed to support you every step of the way, our Apple Watch app helps make travel simpler, faster, and more seamless.
How to get it:
Update to the latest version of our mobile app and enable the Apple Watch app via the Watch app on your iPhone. Once installed, you’re ready to go.

shortText.plaintext: The upgraded Trip Management features a dynamic dashboard design that simplifies navigation, reduces clicks, and prominently displays essential travel information.

longText.html:
The upgraded Trip Management now features a dynamic dashboard design that ensures a seamless and user-friendly experience. This innovative redesign simplifies navigation and reduces the number of clicks required to access vital travel information.

What's New:

Key details such as flight routes and departure times are now prominently displayed on a dynamic flight card. For a trip with multiple flights, you can effortlessly swipe through the cards to view each segment. Scrolling down will reveal additional information, including your baggage status, airport and passenger details and furthermore direct access to the seat map, additional baggage and upgrades as well as various other services are provided at first glance.

With the new Trip Management, staying informed and managing your travel plans has never been more straightforward. Experience the difference with the optimized design, tailored to deliver all your travel needs efficiently and effectively.

And this is only the first great step. Stay tuned for more exciting features and information enrichment coming soon.
